rows.grounds: refers to the yoginī mentioned previously
compound: mat (my) + aurasa (own/legitimate, born of the breast) + samudbhava (born/arisen)

items.question: What filial relationship and origin are attributed to Vinusiṃha in relation to the yoginī and the speaker?
premises: Vinusiṃha is identified as the son of that yoginī.
Vinusiṃha is described as born from the speaker's own body.
The speaker and the yoginī are thus linked as progenitors of Vinusiṃha.
items.inference: Vinusiṃha is the legitimate son of the yoginī, born from the speaker's own body.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of aurasa in this context, whether strictly biological or also signifying legitimacy, is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Vinusiṃha is her son, born from my own body.
